body.name: Exact-support cycle-reversal witness
body.construction: On the order \(L,X_1,X_2,X_3\), \(G_\star\) has equations \(L=\varepsilon_L\), \(X_1=cL+aX_2+\varepsilon_1\), \(X_2=bX_1+\varepsilon_2\), and \(X_3=dL+\varepsilon_3\); \(H_\star\) has equations \(L=\varepsilon_L\), \(X_1=b^{-1}X_2-b^{-1}\varepsilon_2\), \(X_2=-ca^{-1}L+a^{-1}X_1-a^{-1}\varepsilon_1\), and \(X_3=dL+\varepsilon_3\), for \(abcd(1-ab)\ne0\).
